text_for_embedding: query: چند دانشجو در داده‌ها داریم؟ intent: count_query columns: student_metrics.user_id
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS student_count FROM student_metrics;

text_for_embedding: query: میانگین سن دانشجویان مرد چقدر است؟ intent: aggregation_query columns: individuals_core.age individuals_core.gender student_metrics.user_id
sql: SELECT AVG(i.age) AS avg_age FROM individuals_core i JOIN student_metrics s ON s.user_id = i.user_id WHERE i.gender = 'Male';

text_for_embedding: query: تعداد افراد دارای افسردگی در هر استان را بده intent: grouping_query columns: individuals_core.province clinical_assessments.depression_diagnosis clinical_assessments.user_id
sql: SELECT i.province, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS depression_count FROM individuals_core i JOIN clinical_assessments c ON c.user_id = i.user_id WHERE c.depression_diagnosis = 'Yes' GROUP BY i.province ORDER BY depression_count DESC;

text_for_embedding: query: میانگین معدل دانشجویان بر اساس جنسیت چقدر است؟ intent: grouping_query columns: individuals_core.gender student_metrics.cgpa student_metrics.user_id
sql: SELECT i.gender, AVG(s.cgpa) AS avg_cgpa FROM individuals_core i JOIN student_metrics s ON s.user_id = i.user_id GROUP BY i.gender ORDER BY avg_cgpa DESC;
